title: Redistribution-based Cost Inference Improves Sparse Safe Offline RL

extra.description: Safe offline RL typically assumes access to dense per-step cost annotations, but in practice supervisors provide only trajectory-level stop-feedback: a binary signal at the first unsafe transition, with no per-step attribution.
